items.name: hexagonal-architecture
items.author: affaan-m
items.description: Design, implement, and refactor clean Ports & Adapters systems that keep business logic isolated from frameworks and infrastructure.
items.summary: The hexagonal-architecture skill teaches ports and adapters to keep business logic independent from frameworks, transport, and persistence. Core concepts include domain models without framework imports, use cases orchestrating workflows, inbound ports as application commands, outbound ports for repositories and gateways, adapters at HTTP or DB edges, and a composition root binding concrete implementations. Dependency direction flows inward: adapters to application to domain. Six steps model a use case boundary, define outbound ports first, implement pure orchestration, build inbound and outbound adapters, and wire in composition root with slice-by-slice testing using fake ports. Suggested module layout organizes features by domain, application ports and use-cases, adapters, and composition containers. TypeScript examples show OrderRepositoryPort, PaymentGatewayPort, and CreateOrderUseCase with immutable markAuthorized transforms. Multi-language mapping covers TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, and Go package splits. Migration playbook uses strangler approach, facade-first legacy wraps, and characterization tests without big-bang rewrites.
highlights: Ports and adapters: domain, use cases, inbound/outbound ports, adapters, composition root.
Dependency direction inward; domain never imports ORM or framework types.

items.name: refactoring-patterns
items.author: wondelai
items.description: Systematically decompose long, confusing methods into small, intention-revealing ones that are easier to test and maintain.
items.summary: The refactoring-patterns skill Apply named refactoring transformations to improve code structure without changing behavior. Use when the user mentions "refactor this", "code smells", "extract method", "replace conditional", "technical debt", "move method", "inline variable", or "decompose conditional". Also trigger when cleaning up legacy code, preparing code for new features by restructuring, or identifying which transformation to apply to a specific code smell. Covers smell-driven refactoring, safe transformation sequences, and testing guards. For code quality foundations, see clean-code. For managing complexity, see software-design-philosophy. A disciplined approach to improving the internal structure of existing code without changing its observable behavior. Every refactoring follows the same loop: verify tests pass, apply one small structural change, verify tests still pass. Refactoring is not rewriting. It is a sequence of small, behavior-preserving transformations, each backed by tests. You never change what the code does only how it is organized. Big-bang rewrites fail because they combine structural change with behavioral change, making it impossible to know which broke t.
highlights: Smells cluster into five families: Bloaters, Object-Orientation Abusers, Change Preventers, Dispensables, Couplers
Long Method is the most common smell; Duplicate Code is the most expensive
A method that needs a comment to explain what it does is a smell — extract and name the block instead
Shotgun Surgery (one change, many classes) and Divergent Change (one class, many reasons to change) are opposite signals
Primitive Obsession — raw strings/ints instead of small domain objects — spreads errors and duplication

items.name: playwright-skill
items.author: lackeyjb
items.description: Run reliable browser automation, end-to-end tests, visual regression checks, and API validation directly from their coding agent.
items.summary: The playwright-skill provides general-purpose browser automation by writing custom Playwright scripts and executing them through a universal run.js wrapper. The critical workflow starts with auto-detecting dev servers via detectDevServers() before localhost testing, then writes scripts to /tmp/playwright-test-*.js rather than the skill or project directories, and defaults to headless false for visible debugging. Scripts parameterize URLs in a TARGET_URL constant and cover page loads, multi-viewport responsive screenshots, login flows with waitForURL, form fill and submit checks, and broken link scanning. Helpers in lib/helpers.js add safeClick, safeType, cookie banner handling, table extraction, and createContext with custom HTTP headers via PW_HEADER_NAME and PW_HEADER_VALUE environment variables. First-time setup runs npm run setup to install Playwright and Chromium. Inline execution via run.js supports quick one-off tasks while file-based scripts suit complex re-runnable tests. API_REFERENCE.md covers advanced topics like network interception, auth sessions, visual regression, and CI/CD integration when needed.
highlights: Auto-detects running dev servers before localhost testing via detectDevServers().
Writes custom Playwright scripts to /tmp and executes them through run.js.
Defaults to visible browser with headless false unless user requests headless mode.

The core workflow captures baseline metrics, identifies inefficient query patterns and missing indexes, designs targeted optimizations (rewrites, partitioning, lock contention fixes), and validates improvements before production rollout. Output includes performance analysis, bottleneck root causes with EXPLAIN evidence, implementation SQL, and validation queries. items.summary: network-interface-health is an ECC community skill for diagnosing physical-link and switch-port problems that masquerade as application or routing failures. The skill teaches baseline-then-delta counter analysis: capture interface statistics, wait a measurement interval, capture again, and compare increments rather than trusting absolute totals. It documents Cisco-style show interfaces commands, Linux ip -s link, ethtool, and ethtool -S queries, plus SNMP counters such as ifInErrors, ifOutErrors, and ifOutDiscards. A counter reference table explains eight error types—CRC, runts, giants, input drops, output drops, resets, and collisions—with common causes and remediation order. Diagnosis flows separate CRC and input-error investigation from congestion-driven output drops and duplex or speed negotiation mismatches. A bundled Python parser safely slices show interfaces blocks without arbitrary character windows. Developers reach for network-interface-health when monitoring reports rising interface errors or intermittent reachability on a VLAN or WAN link.

items.name: indexion-refactor
items.author: trkbt10
items.description: Systematically detect and remove code duplication at textual, structural, and conceptual levels after adding new abstractions or touching multiple files.
items.summary: The indexion-refactor skill detects and eliminates duplication at textual, structural, and conceptual levels using indexion analysis commands, then verifies single source of truth enforcement. Phase 1 uses plan refactor at 90 percent threshold for duplicate code blocks and function-level duplicates within directories. Phase 2 uses plan solid --from=dirA,dirB for cross-package extraction candidates with apted or tfidf strategies. Phase 3 runs plan unwrap with dry-run then fix to remove trivial delegation wrappers. Phase 4 uses explore for concept-level duplication where files share vocabulary without copy-paste matches. Phase 5 consolidates into SoT: one concept, one module, one function. Phase 6 verifies with re-run refactor, explore, unwrap, and moon test. Phase 7 proves non-recurrence with structural invariant tests. Invoke after new abstractions, file format changes, fixes touching three or more files, guard workarounds, or periodic SoT health checks. Stop signals include platform stubs, type method similarity, CLI boilerplate, and semantic-but-different functions.
highlights: Three duplication levels: textual plan refactor, structural plan solid and unwrap, conceptual explore analysis.
plan refactor finds duplicate blocks and function-level matches with adjustable similarity threshold.
plan solid extracts cross-package shared code with apted or tfidf strategies into a target directory.
plan unwrap dry-run and fix removes trivial single-call delegation wrappers safely.
Seven-phase SoT workflow ends with structural invariant tests preventing duplication recurrence.

items.summary: This skill guides creation of production-grade frontend interfaces with exceptional aesthetic detail and distinctive character.
